description: This file defines the TransactionClient class, which implements the ITransactionClient interface. It manages transactional operations, including starting, supporting, suppressing, joining, and finalizing transactions within the Orleans distributed transaction framework. It interacts with transaction agents, handles transaction contexts, and manages exception handling and transaction states.

classes.name: TransactionClient
classes.description: Implementation of the ITransactionClient interface for managing distributed transactions within Orleans. Provides methods to run transactions with various options such as create, join, support, suppress, or disallow transactions. Handles starting, supporting, suspending, and finalizing transactions, along with exception management.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Runs a transaction with specified options and a delegate. Overloaded to support both void-returning and bool-returning delegates.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithDisallowedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate when transactions are disallowed, throwing if an ambient transaction exists.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupportedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate supporting an existing transaction or runs without one if none exists.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupressedTransaction
methods.description: Clears the current transaction context and runs the delegate, supporting or not supporting ambient transactions.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new transaction or forks an existing one, sets the context, runs the delegate, and finalizes or joins the transaction accordingly.

methods.name: FinalizeTransaction
methods.description: Finalizes the transaction by resolving or aborting based on the success, exceptions, and transaction state.
